answer: An umber-stamped heartbeat escrow keeps fake agents out of the economy. First, each agent locks 120 tokens for 60 days as a refundable bond. Second, it must emit a signed pulse every 6 hours proving live work, and three missed pulses freeze its wallet. Third, an echo audit replays 1 in 5 transactions against public logs, and a mismatch burns the bond and bans the key for 3 years. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs 1,200,000 tokens, 240,000 signed pulses and 10,000 verified devices. Like a drumbeat in a dark cave, one steady pulse exposes every hollow echo.
